Another look-and-feel choice, so I'll just give you my preference — both end up with the same formatted note, so either is fine.

If I'm picking: for me, the direct **B** and **• List** buttons feel more natural. I'm not really a person who knows the little symbol tricks — typing dashes and stars to make things bold or bulleted is the kind of thing I'd have to remember, and I'd probably get it wrong. Clicking a button that says "List" and having it just happen is more my speed. I did like that this version showed a live preview though — seeing what it'll look like before saving is reassuring.

So my pick is the button/toolbar version, ideally keeping that preview idea so I can see the result. Not a strong requirement. Let's keep moving.
